title: Apostles' Creed
desc: Ancient summary of the Christian faith, used in baptism and worship.

title: Nicene Creed
desc: Confession of the full divinity of the Son and the Holy Spirit (325/381).

title: Athanasian Creed
desc: Classic exposition of the Trinity and the Incarnation.

title: Chalcedonian Definition
desc: The two natures of Christ in one person (451).

title: Belgic Confession
desc: Confession of the Reformed Churches of the Netherlands, by Guido de Brès.

title: Heidelberg Catechism
desc: 129 questions about the only comfort in life and in death.

title: Canons of Dort
desc: Response of the Synod of Dort on God's sovereign grace in salvation.

title: Westminster Confession of Faith
desc: Confession of the Presbyterian churches, in 33 chapters.

title: Westminster Shorter Catechism
desc: 107 questions: "What is the main purpose of man?"

title: Second Helvetic Confession
desc: Confession of Heinrich Bullinger adopted by the Swiss Reformed churches (1566).

title: Scots Confession
desc: Confession of the Reformation in Scotland, by John Knox and others (1560).

title: 1689 London Baptist Confession
desc: Confession of Reformed Baptists, based on that of Westminster.
